original_post_text:
"𝑺𝒐𝒎𝒆𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒉𝒂𝒔 𝒃𝒆𝒆𝒏 𝒊𝒏 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒐𝒓𝒌𝒔 𝒃𝒆𝒉𝒊𝒏𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒔𝒄𝒆𝒏𝒆𝒔 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒕'𝒔 𝒂𝒍𝒎𝒐𝒔𝒕 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒚."

The Sham Report is getting a real home.

For those who've been following along on Facebook and now on my Substack, you already know what this publication is about. Texas poker. The real stories. The local coverage the national sites aren't doing. Champions Social Club. The Lodge. And legislation moving through Austin that could change poker in Texas forever.

But a newsletter alone only goes so far. What we've been building is a full media destination built specifically for the Texas poker community.

Part of this journey has been teaching myself how to build it. Web design. Site architecture. How to take a vision in my head and turn it into something real on screen. No shortcuts, no outsourcing it, no excuses. Just figuring it out. That's what 2026 is about for me. No limits.

The screenshot above is just a sneak peek.

Here's what's coming:

Latest News and Investigations. Local DFW coverage and deep dives into the legal and political forces shaping Texas poker. The stories Card Player and PokerNews aren't touching.

Player Recognition. Leaderboards, DFW winners and highlights, ring earners, community spotlights. The players in these rooms every week deserve to be seen. I'm going to make sure they are.

Tournament Calendar. Upcoming DFW events, WSOP Circuit stops, and editorial context you won't find on PokerAtlas.

Texas Room Guide. Not a directory. An opinionated field guide. Texas Card House, Palace Poker, Poker House Fort Worth, Shuffle 214, Champions Social Club. Our honest take on every room.

Media Hub. The full ShamGod Media footprint. Facebook, YouTube, Instagram and more in development. One place for all of it.

This is what Texas poker media looks like when it's built out of passion by someone deeply entrenched in the poker community.

I'm a procurement professional by day, a poker player by night, and apparently a web developer in whatever time is left.

The site is dropping soon. When it does, theshamreport.com will be the place Texas players come first.

If you're not subscribed yet, now is the time. You'll be first to know when we go live and first to see the stories we're working on right now.

More soon.

Shomari Williams
The Sham Report · ShamGod Media LLC

expanded_body:
Originally posted May 13, 2026.

"Something has been in the works behind the scenes and it's almost ready."

The Sham Report is getting a real home.

For those who have been following along on Facebook and on my Substack, you already know what this publication is about: Texas poker. The real stories. The local coverage the national sites aren't doing. Champions Social Club. The Lodge. And legislation moving through Austin that could change poker in Texas forever.

But a newsletter alone only goes so far. What we've been building is a full media destination built specifically for the Texas poker community.

Part of this journey has been teaching myself how to build it — web design, site architecture, and how to take a vision in my head and turn it into something real on screen. No shortcuts, no outsourcing it, no excuses. Just figuring it out. That's what 2026 is about for me: no limits.

Here's what we're building at theshamreport.com:
• Latest News and Investigations: Local DFW coverage and deep dives into the legal and political forces shaping Texas poker — the stories Card Player and PokerNews aren't touching.
• Player Recognition: Leaderboards, DFW winners and highlights, ring earners, and community spotlights. The players in these rooms every week deserve to be seen, and I'm going to make sure they are.
• Tournament Intelligence & Calendar: Upcoming DFW and Texas series, WSOP Circuit stops, and structure analysis you won't find on PokerAtlas.
• Texas Room Guide: An honest take on Texas Card House, Palace Poker, Poker House Fort Worth, Shuffle 214, Champions Social Club, and rooms across the state.
• Media Hub: The full ShamGod Media footprint — Facebook reels, YouTube streams, and hand highlights in one place.

This is what Texas poker media looks like when it's built out of passion by someone deeply entrenched in the poker community. I'm a procurement professional by day, a poker player by night, and a web developer in whatever time is left.

— Sham
Shomari Williams · The Sham Report · ShamGod Media LLC
